1.

Sinners’ Saviour, Jesus, Saviour is He for me also. I, who in sin was bound, Through His grace am now free.

C.

Saviour is He, Sinners’ Saviour here. He gave Himself a ransom, He now my Saviour is.

2.

I know that I am forgiven, Happy, righteous, and free, Saved by my beloved Lord, Saviour is He for me.

3.

Just as I was, He received me, When from judgment I would flee. Now no condemnation remains, Saviour is He for me.

4.

Loved with love unending, I receive blessing rich. How shall I His praise sing? Saviour is He for me.

5.

Soon dawns the glorious day, When His face I shall see. Sing, O my heart, in joy, Saviour is He for me!
